title: WCLI-84 review follow-ups: header-auth test gaps and pinning (Opus review at 391a6e8)
description: Findings from the Opus review of ward-cli#208 (approved, no blocking findings). Should-fix 1: no test keeps the header name and changes the secret alias; sameAuth, profile.ts:472-477: add auth {type:"header", name: NAME, secret:"example.other"} and expect ["auth"]. Should-fix 2: the header-type run test omits the bearer T14 test argv, process.env and file-walk checks. Nit 3: "a changed header name after approval refuses the run before the transport" should also pin exit denied, code profile_approval_stale and zero audit records. Nit 4: no header-type twin of the CR/LF control-byte credential test, so authorization.ts:63 running before the :64-69 branch is unpinned. Nit 5: the consent test "never a value" half cannot fail. Nit 6: normalizedAuth now runs before method and url (profile.ts:458), which changes which code a multi-defect declaration reports.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests for should-fix 1, should-fix 2, nit 3 and nit 4 are added
Each added test is shown to go red under a mutation of the code it guards
